comment: The Gravion model registry — Gravion AI's own models and variants. Status: gravion-core is AVAILABLE (the built-in offline engine every deployment ships with); gravion-chat and gravion-code are AVAILABLE as Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundles since Piece 2; gravion-vision and gravion-audio are AVAILABLE as Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundles since Piece 3; gravion-video is AVAILABLE as a Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundle since Piece 4; gravion-builder is AVAILABLE as a Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundle since Piece 5; gravion-shield and gravion-agent are AVAILABLE as Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundles since Piece 6; the specialist models are also offered as Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles since the tier-packaging piece, and as Tier 4 (Advanced) bundles since Piece 8; gravion-omni is AVAILABLE at Tier 4 (Advanced) since Piece 8; the remaining specialist models are PLANNED and land with their module pieces (see ARCHITECTURE.md roadmap). A deployment may register private variants by placing its own models.json in the deployment home; the same schema and validation apply.

models.name: Gravion Core
models.notes: The built-in engine inside every Gravion deployment. Runs fully offline — no network, no API key — and carries the deployment's name and company policy in its system context.

models.name: Gravion Chat
models.notes: Gravion's trained conversational model for the chat and support modules — long-context, policy-faithful, tuned for company assistants. Piece 2 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Code
models.notes: Gravion's code model for the coder module: generation, review and explanation across a deployment's own stack. Piece 2 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Builder
models.notes: Gravion's site-building model: turns a company brief into a full website and iterates on feedback. Piece 5 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic) and the module's local static-site builder; the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Vision
models.notes: Gravion's image model: generation and editing for brand, product and interface work. Piece 3 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Video
models.notes: Gravion's video model: generation and editing, including long-form output (up to ~1 hour, high quality) produced by the video module's scene-planning and stitching pipeline on top of this model. Piece 4 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic) and the module's local short-clip render pipeline; the long-form stitching pipeline and the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Audio
models.notes: Gravion's music and sound model: tracks, jingles and background scores. Piece 3 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Shield
models.notes: Gravion's security model for the cyber module: defensive analysis, triage and reporting assistance, built from the author's own security research practice. Piece 6 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Agent
models.notes: Gravion's agentic model: plans and runs tool-using workflows, and builds agents for repeatable work. Piece 6 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic) and the module's local plan writer; the Tier 1 (Complete) and Tier 3 (Intermediate) bundles ship with the tier-packaging piece; the Tier 4 (Advanced) bundle ships with Gravion Omni in Piece 8.

models.name: Gravion Omni
models.notes: The all-in-one flagship: one Gravion model serving every capability, offered at the Advanced tier for deployments that want a single model behind every module. Available since Piece 8 with the all-in-one module; it is the only model the runtime accepts behind that package besides a deployment's own custom endpoint model.
